queries.question: How many loan counts by product with a funding line are there?

    COUNT(l.id) AS loan_count
FROM loans AS l

    ON l.product_id = lp.id
WHERE l.funding_line_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lp.id, lp.name
ORDER BY lp.name

    ON l.product_id = lp.id
JOIN funding_lines AS fl
    ON l.funding_line_id = fl.id
GROUP BY lp.id, lp.name
ORDER BY lp.name

JOIN cities ON clients.city_id = cities.id
GROUP BY cities.district_id
ORDER BY cities.district_id

queries.question: Show me the count of clients by district through their city.
queries.sql:
SELECT
    cities.district_id,
    COUNT(*) AS client_count
FROM clients
JOIN cities
    ON clients.city_id = cities.id
GROUP BY cities.district_id

queries.question: Give the number of clients by district through their city.
queries.sql:
SELECT d.name AS district, COUNT(clients.id) AS client_count
FROM clients
JOIN cities AS c ON clients.city_id = c.id
JOIN districts AS d ON c.district_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
